name: Cummins Inc.
research_rationale: Filed Q3 2026 results and strong TTM cash flow support the buy screen, but cyclical truck/pickup softness, leverage and unresolved emissions-related risks still argue for measured conviction.

weekly_updates.summary:
Sources refreshed 17 Nov; Q3 2026 8-K shows $9.4bn revenue, record 18.9% EBITDA and $8.25 diluted EPS, with TTM operating cash flow ~$4.7bn per Yahoo.  
News since 18 Sep is mostly price-action and fund flows; headlines cite Morgan Stanley maintaining coverage with a lower $588 target and a new 1-year low (not verified in filings).  
Management still contrasts strong datacenter power demand with weaker pickup orders; prior regulatory, cyclical and concentration themes are unchanged.
